response.text:
The site already has a service-area section on the home page, the About page and the Contact page, and they all render the towns from the business facts. The Storitve page does not have one, so I'll add it there, as a list, before the closing call to action.

On the Storitve page (index 1), s_cta_storitve is at index 4. Inserting at index 4 puts the new section right before it.

The towns come from serviceArea and are never written into props, so the section only needs a title and an intro.

Variant "list" shows the towns in columns, which suits a section whose whole purpose is to list them. The preceding FAQ section has the default tone, so I'll give this one the alt tone to separate it from the FAQ.
